description.value:
Trigger A creature within your first range increment critically hits you, or reduces an ally within 30 feet to 0 Hit Points.

Requirement You are wielding two loaded firearms.

Make a ranged Strike with each firearm against the triggering creature. Neither counts toward your multiple attack penalty, and both treat the target as off-guard. You may use this once per round and it does not expend your reaction more than once per turn.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP.
